query: SELECT ts,id,jsonb_build_object('id',id,'ts',ts,'type',type,'session_id',session_id,'caller_id',caller_id::text,'tool',tool,'duration_ms',duration_ms,'is_error',is_error,'client_name',client_name,'client_version',client_version,'attrs',attrs,'source',source,'client',client,'caller',caller) AS event FROM events WHERE project_id=$1 AND session_id=$2 AND ts>=$3 AND (ts,id)>($4,$5) ORDER BY ts,id LIMIT 201
